name: remote
label: Remote: models another server serves (another Magpie node, an Ollama), offered on this node as <source>/<model>, through its queue and records

defaults._doc: sources: {name: {"url": "http://host:port", "key": "", "enabled": true}}. Any server answering Ollama's /api/tags, /api/chat, /api/generate and /api/embed works: another Magpie node (its compat module; key = a key of that node with infer scope) or an Ollama (no key). Its models appear here as <name>/<model>, so a program on this node (a knowledge server) uses a stronger machine without being given a route out. embed_names: names (globs) taken as embedding models when the source does not say what a model can do. refresh_s: how often the model lists are read again.
